positions.title: Sr. Web Developer
positions.description:
- Design, develop and deploy MVC applications.  These applications utilized .NET framework, C#, MS SQL, Web Socket, and Angular.
- Work with development teams to implement innovative technical solutions based on .NET framework, provide input to project roadmaps, provide estimates for technical components and technical consulting as required.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Design, develop, test, and debug  KBB.com web application and related KBB industry products utilizing ASP.NET MVC 4.0, Ajax, jQuery and Entity Framework 
•	Design, develop, test, and debug KBB Mobile applications (IOS, Android, and Windows Phone).
positions.insights: Skills: .NET Core · Representational State Transfer (REST) · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)

positions.title: Sr. System Analyst
positions.description:
- Design, develop and deploy ASP.NET application.  These applications utilized .NET framework, C#, RDBMS (Microsoft SQL 2005), and AJAX.
- Work with Managers and Development teams to implement innovative technical solutions based on .NET framework, provide input to project roadmaps, provide estimates for technical components and technical consulting as required 
- Lead design and develop Websphere Portal applications to connect to existing domino applications.
- Design, develop, and deploy enterprise level Websphere Portal applications using RAD v6x0, Websphere Server and Portal Server v6.x
- Work with Managers and Development teams to implement innovative technical solutions based on IBM WebSphere Portal Server, provide input to project roadmaps, provide estimates for technical components and technical consulting as required

positions.title: Senior System Analyst
positions.description:
- Designed and developed in-house web projects using .NET, J2EE (Websphere and Portal), and Domino/Lotus Notes.
- Supported .NET, Java and Notes/Domino applications developers within 3M worldwide.  
- Answered technical development questions and provided answers and troubleshooting support for the development tools such as Microsoft Visual Studio, R4/R5 Domino Designer, Document Management (Version & Workflow)/Quality Document System databases, J2EE applications.
- Developed, analyzed, implemented, documented, and managed new web applications using software engineering development lifecycle and methodology.  
- Collaborated with team members for test planning and test design on many web applications.
